scope: original fictional local fixtures; reviewed reference repairs, not autonomous repairs

cases.title: The missing second page
cases.summary: An integration returns the first page successfully — and silently drops everything after it.
cases.explanation: Follow the next cursor until it ends. Preserve empty pages, duplicate occurrences and identifier strings; stop a repeated cursor before making another request.
cases.impact: A successful HTTP response does not mean a complete result. The repair preserves the full sequence without silently deduplicating records.

baseline.detail: all pages and duplicate occurrences must survive

checks.label: All pages, in order
checks.detail: Duplicate occurrences and distinct identifiers 001 and 1 survive.

checks.label: Empty intermediate page
checks.detail: An empty page with a next cursor continues fetching.

checks.label: Terminal empty page
checks.detail: A single empty page returns an empty list.

checks.label: Cursor cycle stops
checks.detail: A repeated cursor raises ContractError before a redundant request.

cases.title: The identifier that changed
cases.summary: A type conversion strips meaningful zeros and misreads currency amounts.
cases.explanation: Keep identifiers as strings. Convert amounts using an explicit unit contract and exact decimal arithmetic; reject ambiguous or invalid values.
cases.impact: 001 and 1 remain distinct. Currency conversion follows the stated unit instead of guessing from the size of the number.

baseline.detail: invalid literal for int() with base 10: '12.34'

cases.source:
def schema_bug(record, contract):
    return {"id": int(record["id"]), "amount_minor": int(record["amount"])}

checks.label: Identifier preserved
checks.detail: The identifier 001 remains a string with its leading zeros.

checks.label: Explicit amount units
checks.detail: 12.34 major units becomes 1234 minor units; existing minor units stay intact.

checks.label: Invalid values rejected
checks.detail: Fractional minor units, NaN and Infinity raise a contract error.

checks.label: Missing unit rejected
checks.detail: An absent amount unit requires confirmation instead of a guess.

cases.title: The retry that never happened
cases.summary: An expired credential stops a recoverable request. A careless retry could create a different problem.
cases.explanation: Refresh only an expired-token 401. Retry once using the returned token, and preserve every other response without broad retry behavior.
cases.impact: A forbidden request stays forbidden. An expired token gets one controlled recovery attempt, with no unbounded retry loop.

baseline.detail: response must be preserved for expired, seed 3

checks.label: Expired token refreshed once
checks.detail: Exactly one refresh and two requests use the actual replacement token.

checks.label: Other responses preserved
checks.detail: Success, forbidden, server-error and other 401 responses are returned unchanged.

checks.label: Failed replacement stops
checks.detail: A failed replacement response returns without another refresh.

checks.label: Varying fixture values
checks.detail: Three original synthetic seeds check that tokens and responses are not hard-coded.
